data.name: AiS
data.description: AiS (Arbeit in Selbsthilfe gGmbH) is a German non-profit inclusion enterprise in Mössingen/Bodelshausen whose core business is employing people with and without disabilities across agriculture, gastronomy, retail, gardening, a print shop, sewing workshop and manufactory. In 2025 it commissioned a pyrolysis and heating plant at its Kastanienhof site, operated as a "Reallabor" with the University of Tübingen, which converts orchard and landscaping biomass into biochar while heating buildings and greenhouses. Biochar is an adjacent activity layered onto the inclusion business, not the company's raison d'être.
